basics.name: Joe Pegler
basics.label: Staff-level Infrastructure Engineer
basics.specialties: Blockchain Execution · SDKs · Smart Accounts · Cross-Chain Systems
basics.summary: Senior infrastructure engineer building production blockchain transaction and execution systems across EVM and Solana. My work spans backend architecture, typed SDKs, smart-account and cross-chain workflows, translating product requirements and developer journeys into reliable execution systems and APIs. Experienced owning technical verticals from problem definition and architecture through implementation, production rollout, and iteration, balancing reliability, latency, UX, complexity, and time-to-market with product, founder, and engineering stakeholders.

selectedImpact: Designed and operated internal ERC-4337 transaction orchestration and bundler infrastructure at defi.app to improve transaction success, execution latency, gasless UX, and lifecycle control; powered $100M+ daily trading volume with ~95% swap success and 20–40% faster execution than ZeroDev.

Designed and built @biconomy/abstractjs from scratch as a viem-inspired TypeScript developer product, simplifying smart-account and multi-chain workflows through typed APIs, composable abstractions, documentation, and examples; reached ~5.2k weekly npm downloads.

Standardized cross-chain routing and execution across LiFi, Jupiter, 1inch, Odos, Mayan, LayerZero, and Relay, placing EVM and Solana simulation, sponsorship, and transaction safety behind a consistent typed surface shared by frontend and backend teams.

work.summary: Owned transaction execution as a product capability across EVM and Solana, translating product journeys into backend and SDK architecture from route selection and simulation through sponsorship, submission, and production iteration.
highlights: Designed and operated an internal ERC-4337 bundler coordinating wallet pools, nonces, fees, sponsorship policy, simulation, and submission; powered $100M+ daily volume (~5k–7k swaps/day) at ~95% success and 20–40% faster execution than ZeroDev.

Shaped the reliability layer around EntryPoint v7 simulation, guarded retries and fallbacks, ABI/Sourcify-backed error decoding, and structured operational errors, balancing simulation safety and execution speed while improving product and production debugging.

Owned EVM and Solana simulation and sponsorship through production, including Jito-aware safety validation; diagnosed nonce contention, RPC lag, slippage, and simulation-to-execution mismatches, then fed findings back into architecture and execution behaviour.

Standardized LiFi, Jupiter, 1inch, Odos, Mayan, LayerZero, and Relay behind RouteClient and ExecutionManager APIs, preserving provider-specific capabilities within a consistent execution surface used by frontend and backend teams.

work.summary: Owned @biconomy/abstractjs as a developer product, taking Biconomy's TypeScript platform for ERC-4337 smart accounts and multi-chain execution from integration complexity through API design, implementation, documentation, and adoption.
highlights: Designed and built the SDK from scratch, defining viem-inspired abstraction boundaries, modular clients, typed APIs, composable batching, and account-agnostic flows that reduced protocol complexity for application developers.
Took the package through production with documentation and examples for teams integrating gasless and smart-account journeys; grew adoption to approximately 5.2k weekly npm downloads.
Implemented Safe, EIP-712, EIP-1271, ERC-6492, P-256, and passkey compatibility, with production safeguards backed by Vitest, Bun, GitHub Actions, and Codecov.

work.summary: Owned application architecture and production delivery for Enso's primary Ethereum dApp, translating execution journeys into product flows connected to protocol, API, and indexing systems.
highlights: Led the application from early product definition through production, shaping execution UX and defining integration boundaries and API contracts with product, protocol, and backend teams.
Delivered Graph Protocol indexing and intent/routing-adjacent product surfaces, balancing protocol constraints, operational quality, and release delivery.

work.summary: Led engineering delivery for a live trading product, owning interface architecture, team standards, core feature rollout, and release infrastructure.
highlights: Automated CI/CD for the interface stack, improving deployment consistency and reducing release risk in a production trading environment.

earlierExperience: GameAnalytics · Lead Frontend Developer (2016 to 2019): led a team of five, defined architecture and quality standards, and received the company MVP award for 2018/19.
FSI, Healthcare 21, and Nixatel (2013 to 2016): delivered enterprise, mobile, and web products in small engineering teams.
